title: Letter to Edward Partridge and Others, 14 January 1833
source_note: Orson Hyde and Hyrum Smith, on behalf of “a conference of 12 High Priests” (including JS), Letter, Kirtland Mills, Kirtland Township, OH, to “the Bishop his councel and the inhabitents of Zion,” [Jackson Co., MO], 14 Jan. 1833. Retained copy, [ca. 14 Jan. 1833] in JS Letterbook 1, pp. 20–25; handwriting of Frederick G. Williams; CHL. For more complete source information, see the source note for JS Letterbook 1.
